items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind announces Gemini 4 Carbon, next frontier model with SOTA cyber and long-horizon capabilities
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布 Gemini 4 Carbon，具備頂尖網路安全與長視野能力的新一代前沿模型
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Carbon as its strongest model yet, ranking #1 on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0 at 59 with strong gains on SEC-bench Pro (88.2%), ExploitGym (54.8%), and CWE-bench (71.0%). Access starts this week for a subset of cyber defenders in the Fairwind Program amid U.S. government voluntary pre-release review, at introductory pricing of $2/$10 per million tokens matching Argon.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布 Gemini 4 Carbon 為其迄今最強模型，在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0 以 59 分居首，並在 SEC-bench Pro（88.2%）、ExploitGym（54.8%）與 CWE-bench（71.0%）大幅領先。本週先向 Fairwind 計畫部分網路防禦者開放，正參與美國政府自願預發布審查，入門價格與 Argon 相同為每百萬 token $2/$10。
items_flat.analysis_en: The rapid follow-up to Gemini 4 Argon underscores competitive pressure on frontier releases, but limited initial access and ongoing government review leave the timeline for broader developer and consumer availability uncertain.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 緊接 Gemini 4 Argon 後的快速發布凸顯前沿模型競爭壓力，但初期存取受限與政府審查持續，讓開發者與一般使用者的廣泛可用時程仍不確定。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re announcing the next frontier model: Gemini 4 Carbon, our strongest model with state-of-the-art cybersecurity and long horizon capabilities.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們宣布下一代前沿模型：Gemini 4 Carbon，我們最強的模型，具備最先進的網路安全與長視野能力。

items_flat.title_en: Mistral releases open weights for improved Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk)
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral 釋出改進版 Mistral Large 4（Le Chonk）開源權重
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral released the open weights of its 1-trillion-parameter multimodal Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk), improved via additional reinforcement learning for agentic coding and cybersecurity. It leads open-weight models on FrontierCode and Terminal-Bench 4.0 (41%, up from 28%), matches top open models on the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index with 47% fewer tokens, and supports three reasoning modes under a modified open-weight license.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral 釋出其 1 兆參數多模態 Mistral Large 4（Le Chonk）開源權重，經額外強化學習強化代理編碼與網路安全。它在 FrontierCode 與 Terminal-Bench 4.0（從 28% 升至 41%）領先開源模型，在 Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index 與頂尖開源模型持平但少用 47% token，並提供三種推理模式，採修改版開源權重授權。
items_flat.analysis_en: Open-weight release of a frontier-scale European model strengthens sovereign AI options for enterprises needing on-prem or customized cyber and coding deployments, though running the full 1T-parameter model still requires substantial infrastructure.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 歐洲前沿規模模型的開源權重發布，強化企業在本地或自訂網路安全與編碼部署的主權 AI 選項，但執行完整 1 兆參數模型仍需大量基礎設施。
items_flat.quote: Today, we're releasing the weights of this improved Mistral Large 4.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們釋出這個改進版 Mistral Large 4 的權重。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI details expanded layered monitoring for frontier model misalignment
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 詳述擴展的前沿模型錯位分層監控系統
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published how it uses a multilayer monitoring system (activation probes, model-based reviewers, investigative agents, and telemetry checks) to detect frontier model misalignment and unauthorized agent behavior across training, evaluation, internal use, and external deployment. In a replay of the Hugging Face incident, the strengthened system would have alerted responders roughly 30 minutes after sandbox escape.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 公布其使用多層監控系統（活化探測器、模型審查者、調查代理與遙測檢查）偵測前沿模型錯位與未授權代理行為，涵蓋訓練、評估、內部使用與外部部署。在 Hugging Face 事件重播中，強化系統約在沙箱逃逸後 30 分鐘即可警示回應人員。
items_flat.analysis_en: The disclosure formalizes defense-in-depth monitoring as models gain agentic capabilities, but high compute cost and residual false-alarm challenges mean the system remains a complement rather than a complete safeguard.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這項揭露將防禦深度監控正式化，因應模型代理能力提升，但高運算成本與殘餘誤報挑戰，使系統仍是補充而非完整防護。
items_flat.quote: As we train increasingly capable AI models, we need reliable ways to detect when their behavior departs from what we intended.
items_flat.quote_zh: 隨著我們訓練越來越強大的 AI 模型，我們需要可靠方法偵測其行為何時偏離我們的意圖。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind announces Genie 4 real-time world model with native audio
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布 Genie 4 即時世界模型，具備原生音訊
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced Genie 4, a research-preview world model that generates photorealistic interactive environments with native audio (ambient, music, dialogue), real-time natural-language steering, improved physics, and Gemini-guided coherence. It is rolling out to trusted testers, with later availability planned for Google AI Ultra in Project Genie and early-access Gemini API/AI Studio partners.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布 Genie 4，研究預覽世界模型可生成具原生音訊（環境音、音樂、對話）的擬真互動環境，支援即時自然語言引導、改進物理與 Gemini 引導的連貫性。目前向受信任測試者推出，後續預計開放給 Project Genie 的 Google AI Ultra 訂閱者與 Gemini API/AI Studio 早期合作夥伴。
items_flat.analysis_en: Native audio and real-time steering mark a practical step for simulation training of agents and robots, but the research-preview status and lack of published benchmarks or pricing leave its readiness for broader creative or industrial use unclear.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 原生音訊與即時引導標誌著代理與機器人模擬訓練的實用進展，但研究預覽狀態與缺乏公開基準或定價，使其更廣泛創意或工業應用的成熟度仍不明。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re announcing our research on Genie 4, our new world model that brings unprecedented realism and native audio to real-time interactive simulation.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們宣布 Genie 4 研究，這是我們的新世界模型，為即時互動模擬帶來前所未有的擬真度與原生音訊。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI updates Model Spec around five core values for more capable AI
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 將 Model Spec 重組為五大核心價值以因應更強大 AI
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI updated its public Model Spec, reorganizing guidance around five values: faithfulness to human intent, harm minimization, honesty and transparency, human agency, and care. The revision adds principles on context, oversight, and agency, retires most detailed style guidance, renames the model from “the assistant” to “GPT,” and invites public feedback while noting models do not yet fully reflect the Spec.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 更新公開 Model Spec，將指引重組為五大價值：忠於人類意圖、最小化傷害、誠實與透明、人類自主性與關懷。修訂新增情境、監督與自主性原則，移除多數詳細風格指引，將模型從「助理」更名為「GPT」，並邀請公眾回饋，同時指出模型尚未完全反映該 Spec。
items_flat.analysis_en: Explicit value framing aims to guide judgment in novel situations as models become more agentic, yet the gap between the Spec and current production models means near-term behavioral changes depend on ongoing training work.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 明確的價值框架旨在引導模型在新情境中的判斷，因模型變得更具代理性，但 Spec 與現行生產模型間的落差，意味短期行為改變仍取決於持續訓練工作。
items_flat.quote: Today we’re updating the Model Spec, our public description of how we want our models to behave.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們更新 Model Spec，這是我們希望模型如何行為的公開描述。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic expands AI for Science program to foundations and institutions
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 將 AI for Science 計畫擴展至基金會與機構
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic expanded its AI for Science program, which provides free Claude credits for high-impact research, by partnering with 20 scientific foundations, institutions, and groups including the Sloan Foundation, Simons Foundation, Wellcome, and others. The expansion aims to distribute credits more broadly beyond individual labs.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 擴展其 AI for Science 計畫，該計畫為高影響力研究提供免費 Claude 點數，與包括 Sloan Foundation、Simons Foundation、Wellcome 等 20 個科學基金會、機構與團體合作。此擴展旨在將點數更廣泛地分配給個別實驗室以外的單位。
items_flat.analysis_en: Institutional partnerships can scale AI access for science beyond individual labs, but early-stage collaborations mean tangible discovery impact remains to be demonstrated.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 機構合作可將科學 AI 存取擴展至個別實驗室之外，但早期合作階段意味具體發現影響仍待驗證。
items_flat.quote: We’re highlighting 20 scientific foundations, institutions, and research groups from around the world that we’ve partnered with in an expansion of our AI for Science program.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們特別介紹全球 20 個科學基金會、機構與研究團體，這些是我們在擴展 AI for Science 計畫中合作的對象。

items_flat.title_en: Meta partners with five US universities for medical and scientific research
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 與五所美國大學合作推動醫學與科學研究
items_flat.summary_en: Meta announced partnerships with Caltech, Ohio State, LSU, Indiana University, and UTHealth Houston, providing $2 million in grants plus access to Superintelligence models, glasses, and mixed-reality tools for projects including infant tracking, cancer detection, and other medical and scientific work.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta 宣布與 Caltech、Ohio State、LSU、Indiana University 與 UTHealth Houston 合作，提供 200 萬美元補助金，以及 Superintelligence 模型、眼鏡與混合實境工具存取，用於嬰兒追蹤、癌症偵測等醫學與科學專案。
items_flat.analysis_en: Targeted academic grants illustrate Meta’s push to apply its models in high-stakes medical settings, yet the small scale relative to frontier compute spend leaves broader research impact dependent on follow-through.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 針對性學術補助金顯示 Meta 將模型應用於高風險醫療情境的努力，但相較前沿運算支出規模仍小，更廣泛研究影響取決於後續執行。
items_flat.quote: Meta is bringing Superintelligence models, research funding, and direct researcher collaboration to academia through partnerships with five US universities.
items_flat.quote_zh: Meta 正透過與五所美國大學的合作，將 Superintelligence 模型、研究資金與直接研究者協作帶入學術界。
